entries.name: NeonStack
entries.author: @Ben-Scr
entries.shortDescription: Synthwave falling-block puzzler in 3D: neon blocks, bloom, particles, three modes and an original soundtrack.
entries.description:
A complete falling-block puzzle game made with Funke: the classic 10×20 well as a 3D scene with neon blocks, bloom, particles, a colour theme per level, menus and an original soundtrack.

**Modes:** Marathon (endless, a new level every 10 lines), Sprint (40 lines against the clock) and Ultra (two minutes for points). The five best results per mode are saved.

**Rules:** close to the guideline: SRS rotation with wall kicks (180° via SRS+), 7-bag, hold, 5-piece preview, ghost piece, lock delay with move resets, T-spins (mini and full), back-to-back, combos and perfect clears.

**Controls:** Left/Right move, Down soft drop, Space hard drop, Up/X rotate right, Z/Ctrl rotate left, A rotate 180°, C/Shift hold, Esc/P pause. Gamepad supported.

The UI is in German. Scenes, materials, shaders, UI art and music are generated by `Tools/generate.py`; the rules live engine-free in `Assets/Scripts/Core` with tests in `Tools/LogicTests`.
